name: Zeal 0: Grim
text: Over the course of a battle, track the warband's Zeal. As Zeal passes each threshold below, the effect applies to all friendly fighters with the `WITCH HUNTERS` keyword in addition to any threshold already passed. At 0 Zeal: when a friendly fighter makes an attack action against a fighter with an accusation token, you may increase their Fight or Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Zeal 5: Wrathful
text: At 5 Zeal: when a friendly fighter makes an attack action against a fighter with an accusation token, you may turn 1 hit into a critical hit.

name: Zeal 10: Frenzied
text: At 10 Zeal: when a friendly fighter is targeted by an attack action, you may turn 1 critical hit into a hit.

name: Zeal 15: Maddened
text: At 15+ Zeal: all friendly fighters must decrease their Defense characteristic by 1, but will pass any Bravery test they are required to take.
